Container.Name: TapoHubSync
Container.Overview: Mirrors recordings from cameras/doorbells paired to a Tapo hub to local storage. Copy the repo scripts to the host and map them to /app. entrypoint.sh installs ffmpeg + deps on first start, then runs sync_loop.py. First run: open the container console and run `python3 /app/hub_sync.py --setup` to create the encrypted config in /config, then it syncs automatically on a loop.

Config.Name: App dir (scripts)
Config.Description: Host folder containing the repo scripts (hub_sync.py, sync_loop.py, requirements.txt, entrypoint.sh).

Config.Name: Config dir
Config.Description: Holds the encrypted tapohubsync.local.json and .key created by --setup. Persists across reboots.

Config.Name: Sync interval (seconds)
Config.Description: Seconds between sync passes. 0 = sync once and exit.

Config.Name: Config file path
Config.Description: Path to the encrypted config inside the container. Leave as default.

Config.Name: Key file path
Config.Description: Path to the decryption key inside the container. Leave as default.
